Name: Forage For Tinies
Author: svalawoo
Description:
Tiny People have come out to visit Cindersnap forest. They can be foraged, so you can pick them up and carry them around!

This mod adds (fourteen, currently) tiny people to stardew valley. Every day, 6-12 of them should appear in Cindersnap Forest, with different individuals spawning in different seasons. 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is required to add the new content.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url] is needed for the tinies to spawn. I haven't tested it without FTM, but I conjecture that the mod will still work, the tinies will just never appear in game.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14487]Sprites in Detail [/url]is used to make the Tinies more tiny, and more detailed. I would like to make the tinies prettier and more visible in a future update. The mod can probably function without SiD, but it will show different (less detailed, weirder) sprites.





(Dark Humour Warning: [s]You can eat the tinies if you would like to. I'm sure they won't complain.[/s])
